cd /app/tmp/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, time, sys, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/work')
from stress import scenario_mine_heavy, scenario_eval_heavy

def run(req, label):
    text = json.dumps(req)
    t0=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run(['/app/submission/run.sh'], input=text.encode(), capture_output=True, cwd='/app/submission')
    el=time.time()-t0
    try:
        r=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
        info = 'classes=%d members=%d queries=%d' % (len(r.get('classes',[])), sum(c['members'] for c in r.get('classes',[])), len(r.get('queries',[])))
    except Exception as e:
        info = 'BADOUT %r %s' % (p.stdout[:200], e)
    ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    print('%-28s rc=%d wall=%.2fs cpu=%.2fs in=%d out=%d %s' % (label, p.returncode, el, ru.ru_utime+ru.ru_stime, len(text), len(p.stdout), info))
    if p.stderr: print('   stderr:', p.stderr.decode()[:300])

run(scenario_mine_heavy(p=0.5, nsrc=16, B=4, W=1, S=1), 'mine worst-enum p=.5 16src')
run(scenario_mine_heavy(p=0.97, nsrc=2, B=4, W=1, S=1), 'mine p=.97 2src B4')
run(scenario_mine_heavy(p=0.97, nsrc=2, B=3, W=1, S=1), 'mine p=.97 2src B3')
run(scenario_eval_heavy(), 'eval heavy K=8 20atoms')
EOF
